name: Foamit Oyj
summary: Foamit Oyj operates as a dedicated investment firm, primarily allocating capital to businesses that operate within the public sector. Its portfolio specifically includes limited liability companies owned by municipalities, new ventures established through the privatization of municipal services, and private companies that provide services to local authorities. The firm directs its focus toward critical sectors such as energy, social and healthcare, logistics, circular economy initiatives, and waste management. Previously operating under the name Partnera Oy, the company officially rebranded as Foamit Oyj in October 2025. Foamit Oyj is headquartered in Oulu, Finland.
